## SCpubr v3.0.0

Major version update with standardized function names and enhanced features.

### Key changes

- Renamed multiple functions for consistency (see NEWS.md)
- Added colorblind-safe palette support
- Enhanced heatmap functions with text value display
- Improved SeuratObject v5 compatibility

For complete changelog, see the [NEWS.md](https://github.com/enblacar/SCpubr/blob/main/NEWS.md) file on GitHub.
